extracted.name: Simple Cantaloupe Smoothie
extracted.description: This cantaloupe smoothie recipe uses vanilla yogurt blended with fresh cantaloupe and orange juice for a creamy and delicious way to start your day.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup vanilla yogurt (such as Dannon® Light and Fit®)
4 ice cubes, crushed, or as needed
instruction_lines: Process yogurt, orange juice, cantaloupe, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds.
